lines.en: label mikudorm5:
I knock on Miku's door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Miku 的门，等她来应门。

lines.en: The two of us have been getting to know each other a little better lately, so I figure it’s probably fine if the two of us start hanging out somewhere other than the soccer field or the hallway.
lines.zh: 最近我们两个渐渐熟络了一些，所以我想，我们也可以开始在非足球场、非走廊的地方一起玩了。

lines.en: Miku also seems like the type to just let me in without question as well, so there's minimal room for this attempt on getting into her room to somehow fail.
lines.zh: 而且 Miku 看起来就是那种会二话不说放我进去的人，所以这次想进她房间的尝试，几乎没什么失败的空间。

lines.en: : Who goes there?!
lines.zh: : 谁在那儿？！

lines.en: : Hey, Miku. It's me.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Miku。是我。

lines.en: : If this is about homework, I didn't even know we had any! I'll make it up to ya, I swear!
lines.zh: : 如果是作业的事，我根本不知道还有作业！我会补上的，我发誓！

lines.en: : It's not about homework and it likely never will be. I just want to come inside.
lines.zh: : 不是作业的事，而且以后大概也不会是。我只是想进去坐坐。

lines.en: : What? You do? That ain't like, weird for ya or anythin'?
lines.zh: : 啥？真的？你不觉得……那啥，挺奇怪的吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn't have knocked if it was.
lines.zh: : 如果觉得奇怪，我就不会敲门了。

lines.en: : Fine by me! But don't go complainin' when ya realize how boring it is.
lines.zh: : 我没意见！不过等你发现这里有多无聊，可别抱怨啊。

lines.en: scene black
Miku quickly unlocks the door and, just as expected, I'm heading into her room with essentially no resistance whatsoever.
lines.zh: Miku 很快把门打开，正如我所料，我几乎是毫无阻力地走进了她的房间。

lines.en: If I was some kind of horrible person, I might even take advantage of this situation.
lines.zh: 如果我是那种恶劣的人，说不定会趁机利用这种局面。

lines.en: Luckily for Miku and everyone else, I’m a responsible adult with an infallible moral compass who will wait until I get home to sexually fantasize about her.
lines.zh: 对 Miku 和其他所有人来说幸运的是，我是个有责任心、道德指南针绝不出错的成年人，会等到回家以后再对她产生性幻想。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: I don't know. It really depends on how the conversation goes.
lines.zh: 我也不知道。这要看接下来的对话会怎么发展。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm1
: Heya! Welcome to Casa Del Miku! If you're lookin' for Makoto, she ain't around right now.
lines.zh: : 嘿呀！欢迎来到 Miku 之家！你要是找 Makoto，她现在不在。

lines.en: : Then, I guess it's good I came here for you.
lines.zh: : 那么，看来我来找你算是来对了。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm2
: Yeah? You sure you wanna hang out with me of all people? There are at least a zillion other girls in this dorm and they all seem closer to your type than me.
lines.zh: : 是吗？你确定要跟我这样的人混在一起？这宿舍里少说也有几百万个女生，而且她们看起来都比我更符合你的类型。

lines.en: : What do you know about my type, Miku?
lines.zh: : 你又知道我的类型是什么了，Miku？

lines.en: : Beats me but I imagine it involves boobs.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，不过我猜大概跟胸部有关。

lines.en: : So, whatcha wanna do? I was about to go out for a jog, but I guess I can do that later since you don't look like you're up for it.
lines.zh: : 那么，你想干点啥？我本来打算出去跑步的，不过我看你没什么兴趣，那就晚点再去吧。

lines.en: : Come to think of it, you ever even been in our room before? Do I need to break out my tour guide voice?
lines.zh: : 说起来，你以前进过我们房间吗？需要我拿出我的导游腔吗？

lines.en: if makotodorm5 == True:
: Makoto's already shown me around, actually. There was no tour guide voice involved, though.
lines.zh: : Makoto 其实已经带我参观过了。不过她没用导游腔。

lines.en: else:
: You have a tour guide voice?
lines.zh: : 你有导游腔？

lines.en: : Not really. But I wouldn't mind showin' ya around in my normal Miku voice! Which may or may not sound like a tour guide.
lines.zh: : 也不算有。不过我不介意用我平常的 Miku 声音带你逛逛！那声音像不像导游就不好说了。

lines.en: : I ain't ever toured anywhere, so I've got no idea what they actually sound like and don't know why I even mentioned it in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我从来没参加过什么导览，所以我压根不知道导游是什么腔调，也不知道自己一开始为什么要提这个。

lines.en: : You can just go ahead and show me around, then.
lines.zh: : 那你就直接带我逛逛吧。

lines.en: : It’s actually a lot cleaner in here than I imagined it would be. I’m guessing Makoto keeps it that way?
lines.zh: : 这里其实比我想象的干净多了。我猜是 Makoto 维持的？

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm3
: Hey! What the heck is this?! Ya think you can just waltz into a lady’s room and insult her?!
lines.zh: : 喂！这算什么？！你以为能随随便便走进一位女士的房间然后羞辱她吗？！

lines.en: : I’ve got pride too, ya know! I ain't some kinda slob, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我也有尊严的好吗！我又不是什么邋遢鬼，Sensei！

lines.en: : There are half-empty bottles of green tea falling off of your table as we speak.
lines.zh: : 就在我们说话这会儿，你桌上还有几瓶喝了一半的绿茶正要掉下来呢。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm4
: Those are...supposed to be like that! It makes ‘em easier for me to reach!
lines.zh: : 那些是……就该那样放的！这样我才好拿！

lines.en: : Right, right...
lines.zh: : 是是是……

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm5
: Forreal, though! I do my share of the cleanin' too! Don't let those bottles ruin your first impressions of my half of the dorm, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 不过说真的！我也做了我那份打扫！别让那些瓶子毁了你对宿舍我这半边的第一印象啊，Sensei！

lines.en: : Like I said, it's already better than I expected. But if you want to take the next thirty seconds showing me around the rest of the room, feel free.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，这里已经比我预想的好。不过如果你想用接下来三十秒带我看看房间剩下的部分，请便。

lines.en: : Then, follow me! It ain't much, but I'll show ya everything I've got.
lines.zh: : 那就跟我来！东西不多，不过我会把我所有的东西都给你看。

lines.en: : Everything?
lines.zh: : 所有？

lines.en: : Down to the last bottle of tea!
lines.zh: : 连最后一瓶茶都不放过！

lines.en: scene black
Miku doesn't pick up on the innuendo and, instead, guides me over to her bed before taking a seat on it.
lines.zh: Miku 没听出弦外之音，而是把我领到她的床边，然后自己坐了上去。

lines.en: I'm hoping she'll leave room for me as well but, unfortunately, it looks like it'll be a little longer before {i}both{/i} of us can be on it at once.
lines.zh: 我本来希望她也能给我留点位置，可惜看来要等{i}我俩{/i}同时躺上去，还得再过一阵子。

lines.en: In other news, my streak of not sexually fantasizing about Miku comes to an abrupt end just several minutes after it began.
lines.zh: 另外插播一条：我「不对 Miku 产生性幻想」的纪录，在开始几分钟后便戛然而止。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm7
: This here's my bed! Complete with the world's most comfortable body pillow that Makoto got me for my last birthday!
lines.zh: : 这就是我的床！还配有全世界最舒服的抱枕，是 Makoto 去年生日送我的！

lines.en: : I've also got a TV that Makoto got me for my birthday before that! And some posters she got me for some other birthdays!
lines.zh: : 我还有一台电视，是 Makoto 前年生日送我的！还有几张海报，是她别的几个生日送的！

lines.en: : Do you own anything that {i}wasn't{/i} purchased by Makoto?
lines.zh: : 你有哪样东西{i}不是{/i} Makoto 买的吗？

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 基本上没有。

lines.en: : Me and Makoto might not look like it, but we've been BFFs for a while and I've always spent a lot of time around her and her mom.
lines.zh: : 我和 Makoto 可能看起来不像，不过我们当闺蜜好久了，而且我一直花很多时间待在她和她妈妈身边。

lines.en: : Well, your posters could be a little straighter, but I guess you’re right about not being a slob.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你的海报可以贴得更正一点，不过你说自己不邋遢，我想是对的。

lines.en: : The posters ain't even my fault. When you've gotta jump just to get ‘em high enough on the wall, it ain't that easy to make 'em stick.
lines.zh: : 海报贴歪真不怪我。你得跳起来才能把它贴到墙上够高的位置，想贴正可不容易。

lines.en: : Ya might not realize this since you’re a billion feet tall, but us short folk have it pretty rough.
lines.zh: : 你可能有十亿英尺高，体会不到，但我们矮个子日子可不太好过。

lines.en: : Thankfully, the bed is bouncy enough that I can get up pretty high without much trouble!
lines.zh: : 幸好这张床弹性够好，我不费什么劲就能弹得挺高！

lines.en: : Oh, here's an idea! Wanna jump on the bed with me? Makoto ain't here, so we won't even get in trouble.
lines.zh: : 哦，我有个主意！要不要跟我一起在床上跳？Makoto 不在，我们不会被骂的。

lines.en: : I think I'll have to respectfully decline.
lines.zh: : 我想我还是恭敬地拒绝吧。

lines.en: : Guess that makes sense. Somebody your size would probably hit his head if he jumped on this anyway.
lines.zh: : 也是。反正你这么大块头，跳上去大概会撞到头。

lines.en: : I’d also probably break your bed and I don't want you to have to sleep on the floor.
lines.zh: : 而且我大概还会把你的床压塌，我可不想让你睡地板。

lines.en: : Nah. I'm sure it’s strong enough to support the two of us as long as we’re not doin’ anything crazy.
lines.zh: : 不会啦。我敢肯定，只要我们不做太疯狂的事，它撑得住我们两个。

lines.en: The fantasies continue.
lines.zh: 幻想还在继续。

lines.en: : Would you mind describing what sorts of {i}crazy{/i} things you're referring to, Miku?
lines.zh: : 你能不能具体说说，你指的「{i}疯狂{/i}的事」是哪种，Miku？

lines.en: : That sounds like a question for Makoto. I don't know the first thing when it comes to crazy bed activities. I just know she doesn't like it when I jump too high.
lines.zh: : 这问题该去问 Makoto。疯狂的床上活动我可一窍不通。我只知道她不喜欢我跳得太高。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like Makoto could benefit from jumping on the bed herself.
lines.zh: : 听起来，Makoto 自己也该在床上跳跳，对她有好处。

lines.en: : That’s what I keep tellin’ her but she’s always like “Miku, you’re gonna break your legs and I can't afford that kind of medical bill!”
lines.zh: : 我一直都这么跟她说，可她总是那句：「Miku，你会把腿摔断的，我可付不起那种医药费！」

lines.en: scene black
Miku picks herself up off the bed and heads over to a balance beam set up underneath her dry erase board.
lines.zh: Miku 从床上爬起来，走向架在她白板下面的那根平衡木。

lines.en: Why she has a balance beam in her room, I have no idea. But I guess I’m not too surprised given the type of girl she is.
lines.zh: 她房间里为什么会有一根平衡木，我完全不知道。不过想想她是哪种女孩，我也就不太惊讶了。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm8
: You ever broken a bone before, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你以前骨折过吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I don't...think so? But I could be wrong.
lines.zh: : 我……应该没有？不过也可能记错了。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm9
: Probably not, then. You'd definitely remember it if you ever broke somethin'.
lines.zh: : 那大概就是没有。要是真断过什么，你肯定会记得。

lines.en: : Yeah, I'm not quite sure about that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这我可不太确定。

lines.en: : No, really. It hurts like heck and takes forever to get better.
lines.zh: : 不，真的。疼得要命，而且要好久才能好。

lines.en: : I take it you {i}have{/i} broken something, then?
lines.zh: : 这么说，你{i}断过{/i}什么了？

lines.en: : Well, I...yeah.
scene mikufirstdorm8r
: But I mean...that sorta thing is expected when you're somebody like me, right?
lines.zh: : 不过我是说……像我这样的人，会碰上这种事也是意料之中吧？

lines.en: : Crazy how easily bones can break even when ya go through so much conditioning, right?
lines.zh: : 明明做了那么多训练，骨头还是那么容易断，真是够扯的，对吧？

lines.en: : The human body is surprisingly fragile.
lines.zh: : 人体脆弱得出人意料。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm8
: Darn right it is! That’s why I thank my organs every morning!
lines.zh: : 一点没错！所以我每天早上都会感谢我的器官！

lines.en: : You do...what?
lines.zh: : 你……你说什么？

lines.en: : Ya know. Thank ‘em for performin’ their daily functions! Kinda like I thank all the girls on the soccer team after a successful practice.
lines.zh: : 你知道的。感谢它们履行日常职责！就像一次成功的训练之后，我会感谢足球队里所有女孩子一样。

lines.en: : Your body’s kinda like its own team, don'tcha think?
lines.zh: : 你的身体有点像一个自己的团队，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : All those weird parts inside of ya, movin’ around and pumpin’ blood! Keepin’ viruses and parasites from turnin’ yer organs to mush!
lines.zh: : 你身体里那些奇奇怪怪的部件，四处活动、泵着血液！还得防着病毒和寄生虫把你的器官变成一摊烂泥！

lines.en: : Without teamwork, ya’d be as good as dead!
lines.zh: : 没有团队合作，你就跟死了一样！

lines.en: : So...you thank your organs to prevent them from turning into mush?
lines.zh: : 所以……你感谢你的器官，是为了防止它们变成一摊烂泥？

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm10
: Well, of course it sounds weird when ya word it like that!
lines.zh: : 你那么一说，当然是听起来很怪啦！

lines.en: : I like to think of it as just the right thing to do, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我愿意把它当成一件理所当然该做的事。

lines.en: : Besides, we've all got our own weird habits and stuff!
lines.zh: : 再说了，谁还没有点自己的怪毛病呢！

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm8
: I'm sure you've got plenty too, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我相信你肯定也有不少，Sensei！

lines.en: : Don't be too sure. I'm not very exciting.
lines.zh: : 别太肯定。我这人挺无聊的。

lines.en: : Really? No weird habits at all? Nothin' that yer’ too embarrassed to tell anyone else about?
lines.zh: : 真的？一点怪毛病都没有？没有那种……不好意思跟别人说的事？

lines.en: : Your old pal Miku can keep a secret! I won’t tell anyone. Scout's honor!
lines.zh: : 你的老朋友 Miku 可是会保密的！我不会告诉任何人。以童子军的荣誉起誓！

lines.en: I'm not sure if they count as habits, but there are absolutely things about myself I can't tell anyone else about- and that includes Miku.
lines.zh: 我不确定那些算不算怪毛病，但关于我自己，绝对有些事是我不能告诉任何人的——Miku 也包括在内。

lines.en: Well...at least for now.
lines.zh: 至少……目前是这样。

lines.en: : No weird habits, I don’t think. I'm glad to know you can keep a secret, though. I’ll try to keep that in mind in the event that I ever decide to open up.
lines.zh: : 怪毛病，我想没有。不过很高兴知道你会保密。如果有一天我决定敞开心扉，我会记着这点的。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm11
: Sounds good to me! I'm all about the juicy stuff and I know when to keep my lips sealed!
lines.zh: : 没问题！我最爱听劲爆的内容了，而且我知道什么时候该闭紧嘴巴！

lines.en: : And I will keep that in mind even more than the last thing you said.
lines.zh: : 这一点我会记得比你上一句话还牢。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm8
: Great! Cause whenever ya need me, I’m all yours!
lines.zh: : 太好了！因为你需要我的时候，我整个人都是你的！

lines.en: I can't tell if Miku is saying slightly provocative things on purpose or if she is just...incapable of thinking before speaking.
lines.zh: 我分不清 Miku 是故意说这些略带挑逗的话，还是她只是……说话前不过脑子。

lines.en: Actually, I'm pretty sure it's the latter now that I've actually put words to it.
lines.zh: 不过真的说出口之后，我倒挺确定是后者了。

lines.en: : I'll lend ya a hand whenever ya need it, Sensei! {i}Two{/i} hands if one ain't big enough.
lines.zh: : 你需要的时候我随时帮你一把，Sensei！要是一只手不够，我还有{i}两只{/i}。

lines.en: Okay, and now I'm unsure again.
lines.zh: 好吧，这下我又不确定了。

lines.en: scene black
Miku pulls herself off of the balance beam, informally concluding our tour, before returning to the center of her room.
lines.zh: Miku 从平衡木上下来，我们的参观也就这么非正式地结束了，随后她走回房间中央。

lines.en: I follow her, sensing that it will very likely be time for me to leave soon as an extended session with the two of us alone might be a bit much for a first visit.
lines.zh: 我跟了过去，感觉自己大概很快就得走了——毕竟第一次来访就独处这么久，可能有点过火。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm5
: Hey...you mind if I ask ya a question really quick, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嘿……我能很快问你个问题吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Sure. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 当然。怎么了？

lines.en: : Before I ask, I've gotta say that I'm really only doin' this for Makoto's sake, though.
lines.zh: : 不过在问之前，我得说，我真的只是为了 Makoto 才问的。

lines.en: : Like, sure I'm curious! But not as much as her. So she's the real reason this is happenin' right now.
lines.zh: : 就是说，我也确实好奇啦！但没她那么好奇。所以她才是这件事发生的真正原因。

lines.en: : I'm confused. Are you asking me? Or is Makoto asking me {i}through{/i} you?
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。是你在问我？还是 Makoto {i}借你的嘴{/i}在问我？

lines.en: : Maybe...we're both askin' you at the same time? Just she's only here in spirit, so the talkin' part falls onto me.
lines.zh: : 也许……我们两个同时在问你？只是她只在精神上到场，所以说话的部分就落到我头上了。

lines.en: : ...I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : ……抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : I just-
lines.zh: : 我只是——

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm11r
: I...kinda wanna know what sorta girls you're into!
lines.zh: : 我……有点想知道你喜欢什么样的女生！

lines.en: : For Makoto's sake! Not mine! Because...I obviously ain't your style!
lines.zh: : 是为了 Makoto！不是为了我！因为……我显然不是你喜欢的类型！

lines.en: : Why do you keep assuming you know my style?
lines.zh: : 你为什么总以为自己知道我喜欢什么类型？

lines.en: : And why even ask in the first place if you're expecting me to say something that will put you down?
lines.zh: : 而且如果你早就等着我说些贬低你的话，那一开始又何必问？

lines.en: : Is this some sort of trap or something?
lines.zh: : 这是某种圈套之类的东西吗？

lines.en: : Course not. It ain't about bein' put down. I'm not worried at all about that sorta thing.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。这不是什么贬低不贬低的事。那种事我一点都不担心。

lines.en: : I'm just wonderin' since...I've got a feelin' you and me are gonna be good pals soon. And I wanna know more about you so I can be a better friend.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道，因为……我有种感觉，你和我很快就会成为好朋友。我想多了解你一点，这样我才能当个更好的朋友。

lines.en: : That's nice. But I'm not going to answer your question.
lines.zh: : 这挺好的。不过我不会回答你的问题。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm3
: What?! Why not?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！为什么不行？！

lines.en: : Because that's not a question that can be easily answered.
lines.zh: : 因为这不是一个能轻易回答的问题。

lines.en: : I'm into whoever I'm into and I'm not going to favor anyone just for presenting themself a certain way.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢谁就是喜欢谁，我不会因为谁表现成某个样子就偏袒谁。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm11r2
: Woah! Sensei...are you actually {i}cool?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 哇哦！Sensei……你其实挺{i}酷的吧？……{/i}

lines.en: : That sounded like a thing a cool person would say. You're like the love interest in a shoujo manga all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 那听起来像是酷的人才会说的话。你突然变得像少女漫画里的男主角了。

lines.en: : Thanks?
lines.zh: : 谢谢？

lines.en: : I'm telling the truth, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我说的是真话。

lines.en: : You're just as much my type as anyone else, Miku.
lines.zh: : 你和别人一样，都在我喜欢的类型之内，Miku。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm11r3
: Thanks, Sensei. Ya ain't gotta say stuff like that to me, though. I really {i}do{/i} just wanna get to know ya better.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Sensei。不过你不用对我说这种话啦。我是{i}真的{/i}想多了解你一点。

lines.en: : Hangin' out with you's fun...and I want you to come around some more.
lines.zh: : 跟你在一起很开心……而且我希望你能多来几趟。

lines.en: : Then, I'll be sure to do that.
lines.zh: : 那么，我一定会多来的。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm11r4
: A-Anyway! I’m glad we’re on the same page!
lines.zh: : 总、总之！很高兴我们想到一块儿去了！

lines.en: : Just...don’t tell Makoto that we’re buds now or she’ll get super jealous, got it?!
lines.zh: : 不过……别跟 Makoto 说我们现在是哥们儿了，不然她会超级吃醋的，明白吗？！

lines.en: : Got it. Same goes for you. No one will know this meeting ever even happened.
lines.zh: : 明白。你也一样。没有人会知道这次见面的事。

lines.en: scene mikufirstdorm11r5
: Don’t gotta tell me twice, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 不用跟我说第二遍，Sensei！

lines.en: : Secret friendship...ACTIVATE!
lines.zh: : 秘密友谊……启动！

lines.en: scene black
Despite me sensing that it was time to leave, Miku and I hang out in her room for another hour or two before I finally head back home.
lines.zh: 尽管我早就觉得该走了，Miku 和我还是在她房间里又待了一两个小时，我才终于动身回家。

lines.en: And just in time as well, as I bump into Makoto returning home from work on my way out of the dorm.
lines.zh: 而且时机刚刚好——我走出宿舍时，正好撞见 Makoto 下班回来。

lines.en: I’m glad that Miku and I are close enough to hang out like this now.
lines.zh: 我很高兴 Miku 和我如今已经亲近到可以这样一起玩了。

lines.en: But I'm even more glad that she's already starting to show her first signs of weakness.
lines.zh: 但我更高兴的是，她已经开始露出第一丝破绽了。

lines.en: $ mikudorm5 = True
$ miku_love += 1
{i}Miku’s affection has increased to [miku_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Miku 的好感度提升到了 [miku_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}You can now spend time with her in her room!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}现在你可以去她的房间陪她了！{/i}
